name: neon-serpent
description: Neon Serpent — browser snake game with power-ups and coding-quiz revivals

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=dist/game.js
scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/game.js --watch --servedir=dist
